title: Welcome to the AX Portal
description:
A better digital experience

We are pleased to welcome you to the AX Portal. Our updated website makes it easier to find information, access services, and stay informed.

  • Simple navigation across key pages
  • A dedicated announcements section
  • Improved display on mobile and desktop

Visit the portal home page to get started.

Thank you for being part of our community.

title: Scheduled Website Maintenance
description:
Planned maintenance notice

We will perform routine maintenance on 28 November 2026, 10:00 PM to 11:30 PM IST. Some website services may be temporarily unavailable.

  • Save any unfinished work before the maintenance window.
  • Avoid submitting forms during the scheduled period.
  • Refresh the website after maintenance is complete.

We appreciate your patience.

title: New User Dashboard Features
description:
What is new?

The dashboard now provides a clearer overview of recent activity and important updates.

  1. Sign in to your account.
  2. Open the Dashboard section.
  3. Review your latest activity and available shortcuts.

Learn more on the dashboard page.

title: How to Update Your Profile
description:
Keep your details up to date

Accurate profile information helps us provide a smooth experience.

  1. Open Account Settings.
  2. Select Edit Profile.
  3. Review and update your information.
  4. Select Save Changes.

For account assistance, use the support page.

title: Mobile Experience Improvements
description:
Browse comfortably on any device

We have refined spacing, navigation, and form layouts for smaller screens.

  • Larger touch-friendly buttons
  • Better readability on phones
  • Improved form alignment

These improvements are available automatically when you open the website on your mobile device.

title: Security Reminder: Protect Your Account
description:
Account safety tips

Please follow a few simple practices to keep your account secure.

  • Use a strong, unique password.
  • Never share your password or verification codes.
  • Sign out when using a shared computer.
  • Check website links before entering account details.

Remember: Our team will never ask you to share your password.

title: Document Upload Guidelines
description:
Prepare documents before uploading

For a smoother form submission, ensure each uploaded document is readable and relevant to the requested field.

  • Use clear, properly oriented scans or photos.
  • Check the file type and size limits shown in the upload form.
  • Preview each attachment before submitting.

Go to My Forms to continue.

title: Feedback and Suggestions Are Welcome
description:
Help us improve

We welcome ideas that make the website easier and more useful for everyone.

  • Tell us which feature you use most often.
  • Report confusing text or difficult navigation.
  • Suggest improvements to existing services.

Share your thoughts through the feedback form.

title: Previous Interface Update
description:
Earlier interface improvements

An earlier website update introduced refreshed navigation labels and improved content spacing.

This notice is now archived because newer interface announcements supersede it.

title: Completed Maintenance Notice
description:
Maintenance completed

The planned maintenance activity for October has been completed.

This announcement is retained for historical reference and is no longer active.
